title: Earth and Fire: Alternative Firing Techniques
summary: Five-day workshop in alternative firings (Raku, Horsehair, Tin Foil Saggar, Obvara) at Truro Center for the Arts. Participants bring bisque pieces; firings occur daily. No pottery making during the week.
bring: Bisque pieces and green ware ceramic pieces no larger than 10" tall and 5" wide (4-5 bone dry for terra sig, 4-5 bisqued pieces), cotton long sleeve shirt and long pants, closed-toed shoes, cotton head covering, brushes, face mask, rubber gloves, notebook, lunch/snacks/water
source_quote:
Earth and Fire: Alternative Firing Techniques
Location: Truro Center Castle Hill for the Arts
Dates: Monday, August 25, 2025 – Friday, August 29, 2025
evidence_sentence: The workshop page lists Raku, Horsehair, Tin Foil Saggar, and Obvara as firing techniques with a Raku kiln used for various firing applications.
evidence_quote: Join Lois for this fun and exciting workshop to explore a variety of alternative firing techniques. Engage with fire and smoke to explore Horse Hair, Western Raku, Tin Foil Saggar, Obvara and the spontaneous and unpredictable magic of these alternative firing techniques. Firings will take place each day. Students will learn how to use a Raku kiln for a variety of firing applications
